svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Standoffs (make 4): cut 20 x 20 x 1.5 mm tube to 130 mm. Cope one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end to fit the 28 mm rail (file to a 14 mm radius saddle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld a 3 mm cap on the other end; drill 4.2 and tap it M5.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld each standoff square to the back of a rail, 140 and 510 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the shaft line, so the capped ends stand 100 mm behind

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shaft line (90 mm to the cap face).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skids (2): UHMW strip 25 x 10 mm cut to 500 mm. Countersink two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 100 and 470 mm from the lower end; screw to the caps with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M5 countersunk screws, heads below the skid face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The skid runs from 40 to 540 mm above the shaft line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both skid faces in one plane, within 1 mm; the cluster

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: turns past them with 15 mm or more to spare.
